subject: Inquiry about the control of the loop conditions when doing simulation study of Bayesian CFA model

messages.author: dd68762ffa97bc2c
messages.subject: Inquiry about the control of the loop conditions when doing simulation study of Bayesian CFA model
parts:
Hi, team,
I am doing a simple simulation study about one-factor CFA Bayesian model.
I have 18 conditions in total: factor loading(0.2, 0.8); sample size(30,70,100); prior(N~(0,+infinity); N~(1,0.01); N~(1,1)) ========conditions:2*3*3=18.
According to the guidance on “MplusAutomation Example.pdf" online, I wrote the syntax and  it really can work in practice.

Here the 3 iterators are ss(sample size) facpm(factor loading prior mean); facpv(factor loading for prior variance)

However, I found a problem that the code running through many unnecessary conditions.(For example,  for the set up of priors: what I want is 
( prior(N~(0,+infinity); N~(1,0.01); N~(1,1)) ) while the code gave me the results:(The last 3 priors are not experimental conditions)
N~(0,+infinity); N~(1,0.01); N~(1,1)     ;N~(0,1);  N~(0,0.01); N~(1,+Inf)

I try to use "conditional tags" or "list tags" to control it but failed. I have to remove those additional .outputs and .inps from my working directory.
Is there anybody can help me to solve this problem? For the ease of communication, I put my code here:Thank you!

setwd("d:/fanlin")
library(MplusAutomation)
sink("datagene1.inp")

    iterators=ss facpm facpv;
